title: When LLM Architectures Meet Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection: a Replication Study
title_zh: 当大语言模型架构遇上智能合约漏洞检测：一项复制研究

paragraphs.en: 复制研究发现GPT-4检测智能合约漏洞的高召回低精度模式并非在所有大模型架构间一致迁移。 Smart contracts are immutable programs deployed on blockchain platforms, where vulnerabilities can translate directly into financial loss. Among the techniques proposed for their detection, recent work has relied increasingly on Large Language Models (LLMs) guided by carefully crafted prompts. However, the evidence accumulated so far rests almost entirely on the dense Transformer architecture behind the GPT line and on model snapshots already scheduled for deprecation, leaving open the question of whether the reported behaviors reflect a general property of LLMs or an artifact of that specific design. This paper presents an extended replication of the empirical study by Chen et al. on LLM-based smart contract vulnerability detection. We replicate the original protocol on GPT-4 as a baseline, followed by a differentiated replication, executing the protocol on representative models based on Mixture-of-Experts and RNN-like designs, together with an attempted preliminary evaluation of State Space Models. The exact replication confirms the findings of Chen et al., including the high-recall, low-precision detection pattern they report on GPT-4. Nevertheless, the differentiated replication shows that this pattern does not transfer uniformly across the evaluated models. Those from the same architectural family may also exhibit different behaviors, indicating that architectural family alone is insufficient to predict the resulting detection profile. We observe the same qualitative dense-Transformer profile in both GPT-4 and Gemma-3, despite a gap of roughly two orders of magnitude in parameter counts, whereas two Mixture-of-Experts models from different lineages exhibit qualitatively divergent behaviors, indicating that architectural family alone is insufficient to predict the detection profile.
paragraphs.zh: 复制研究发现，GPT-4在检测智能合约漏洞时表现出的高召回低精度模式并非在所有大模型架构间一致迁移。智能合约是部署在区块链平台上的不可变程序，其漏洞可能直接转化为经济损失。 在已提出的漏洞检测技术中，近期研究日益依赖于由精心设计的提示所引导的大语言模型（LLMs）。 然而，迄今积累的证据几乎完全基于GPT系列背后稠密Transformer架构以及已被列入弃用计划的模型快照，这使得报告的行为究竟反映的是大语言模型的普遍特性，还是该特定设计的产物，这一问题仍然悬而未决。 本文对Chen等人基于大语言模型的智能合约漏洞检测实证研究进行了一次扩展复制。 我们首先在GPT-4上复制原协议作为基线，随后进行差异化复制，在基于混合专家和类RNN设计的代表性模型上执行该协议，并对状态空间模型进行了一次尝试性的初步评估。 精确复制证实了Chen等人的发现，包括他们报告的GPT-4上的高召回低精度检测模式。 尽管如此，差异化复制表明该模式并未在所评估的模型间一致迁移。 属于同一架构家族的模型也可能表现出不同的行为，这表明仅凭架构家族不足以预测最终的检测特征。 我们在GPT-4和Gemma-3中观察到相同的定性稠密Transformer特征，尽管两者参数量相差约两个数量级；而来自不同谱系的两个混合专家模型则表现出定性上分歧的行为，这同样表明仅凭架构家族不足以预测检测特征。
